items.title: Contraline secures $92.5m to push male contraceptive into late-stage trials
items.summary: Contraline could become the first to commercialise a reversible male contraceptive drug, provided the treatment is successful in Phase III.

items.title: AbbVie receives EC approval for Aquipta to treat migraine
items.summary: AbbVie has received approval from the EC for Aquipta, an oral CGRP receptor antagonist, for the acute treatment of migraine in adults, with or without aura.

items.title: Roche’s giredestrant secures FDA priority review for breast cancer
items.summary: The US FDA has accepted priority review of the NDA for Roche’s investigational oral SERD, giredestrant, for breast cancer.

items.title: ASCO26: Bispecific antibody and RET fusion-targeting assets garner attention in NSCLC
items.summary: While Summit’s Harmoni-6 results drew a mixed reaction, Eli Lilly’s positive Retvemo data was expanded its potential in adjuvant NSCLC.

items.title: ASCO 2026: Kelonia presents positive in vivo CAR-T data in multiple myeloma
items.summary: Early data suggest KLN-1010, now acquired by Eli Lilly, could be more tolerable but less efficacious that AstraZeneca’s ESOT-01.
